title: Sign Language Interpreting
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Sign Language Interpreting - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - AS505/AS505C/CE505
outcomes: Produce documented completion of a total of 54 observation hours, 27 mentorship hours, and 92 practicum hours.
Provide a completed portfolio, including, but not limited to, a resume, an introductory letter, business cards, intake form, invoice form, and Interpreter Kit.
Demonstrate entry-level interpreting skills before an exiting panel at the end of the 4th interpreting skills class.

notes: The page prints a single section and requirements list for both the A.S. degree and the Certificate of Achievement; the certificate is read as sharing this Required Courses list (28.50 units) and the program learning outcomes list.
The section heading is printed three times with slightly different award codes (AS505/AS505C/CE505 twice, AS505/AS505B/AS505C/CE505 once); the first was used.
Codes are printed with a hyphen (e.g., ASL-5); they are matched to the closed list's space-separated codes (ASL 5, etc.).

ASL-10 Introduction to Sign Language Interpreting (3.00 units) is not in the closed list and is recorded as a catalog addition. The individual course units (4+3+4.5+4.5+4.5+2+3+3) sum to 28.50, consistent with the printed total.
ASL-11, ASL-12, ASL-13, ASL-14 and ASL-20 are marked '( Historical )' in the catalog while still listed as required; a reviewer may want to confirm their current status for the 2026-2027 year.
